The '''''Fear and Futility''''' was a [[Warlord Heavy Cruiser]] used by the [[Void Wings/Legends|Void Wings]] pirates during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it operated in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel]] and [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk systems]] where it was spotted together with a group of Void Wings [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The ship was destroyed<ref name="SWG:VWPQT5" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Fear and Futility'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:VWPQT5" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Fear and Futility'' was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|Chapter 8]],"<ref name="SWG:VWPQT5" /> on [[January 15]], [[2008]],<ref name="C8">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref> Players had to destroy the ship 25 times to complete the [[W:c:swg:Hidden Daggers Pilot Quota Tier 5|"Void Wing Pilot Quota Tier 5" collection]].<ref name="SWG:VWPQT5" />
